title: CV of Hannah Kowalski
summary: Data Analyst and Analytics Engineer - SQL, dashboards, pipelines; 6 years; employers: Brightcart, Meridian Mutual, Independent (freelance)

title: Trading KPI dashboard for an online retailer
summary: I built an automated weekly KPI dashboard that replaced two days of manual spreadsheet work, and it now serves 120 regular users each Monday morning. The new system delivers up‑to‑date margin, sell‑through and stock‑cover metrics with a single click.

title: Checkout redesign experiment analysis
summary: I built a robust experiment analysis pipeline that used pre‑experiment behaviour to reduce variance, and delivered a confirmed 3.1% lift in conversion while preventing a costly false‑positive launch.

title: Claims leakage analysis
summary: I built a claim‑by‑claim leakage detection system that cross‑checked payments against policy wording, and it identified over £1.2 M of annual over‑payments. The insight led to two process improvements that were adopted across Meridian Mutual’s claims team.

title: Automating monthly client packs for an accountancy firm
summary: I built an automated monthly client pack generator that pulls figures from ledger exports with a single click, and it now saves the firm 30 staff hours each month while almost eliminating errors.

title: Transcribing interviews for a podcast
summary: I transcribed twelve podcast episodes for a media client, turning spoken interviews into clear, searchable text. The client now has fully indexed transcripts ready for publication and repurposing.

title: Weekly competitor price collection
summary: I built an automated weekly web‑scraping pipeline that gathered competitor pricing data every Monday, and it reliably delivered around 1,500 price points for the client’s retail analysis. The system freed up their team to focus on strategy rather than manual data collection.

title: Nightly data loads for a direct-to-consumer brand
summary: I built an automated nightly pipeline that consolidates sales and email data into a single source of truth, and delivered a ready‑to‑use morning report for the Fernway team. The solution gave them reliable, up‑to‑date insights before their daily stand‑up, improving decision‑making speed.

title: Google Sheets CRM with automatic reminders
summary: I built a Google Sheets‑based CRM that automatically sent reminder emails for client follow‑ups, and the client now never misses a scheduled contact. The spreadsheet automation streamlined their workflow and improved client retention.

title: Updating a Wix site for a yoga studio
summary: I updated a yoga studio's Wix website to fix a broken timetable and add clear booking links. The new layout is now live and students can easily sign up for classes.

title: Marketing attribution models for a subscription app
summary: I built an automated attribution pipeline that turned raw event logs into daily channel‑level acquisition costs, and the client re‑allocated 18% of their ad spend to cheaper media, cutting CAC by 11%.

title: Staff attrition dashboard
summary: I built a staff attrition dashboard that highlighted turnover hotspots by site and manager, using SQL and visualisation techniques. The client could now spot problem areas quickly and take targeted action to improve retention.

title: Retention and onboarding drop-off study
summary: I built a cohort‑based retention analysis that identified a critical early‑stage drop‑off and recommended an onboarding tweak, which lifted week‑four retention by five percentage points.

title: Simple sales forecast for a Shopify store
summary: I built a simple sales forecast model for a Shopify store using time‑series techniques, and the client could now plan stock orders eight weeks in advance. The forecast gave them confidence to keep inventory levels tight while avoiding stock‑outs.

title: SQL tutoring for a career changer
summary: I delivered a series of one‑to‑one SQL tutoring sessions that equipped the learner with practical query writing skills. The student then succeeded in two technical interviews and secured a data‑focused role.

title: Beneficiary survey analysis for a food charity
summary: I built a set of weighted, visual KPI dashboards that turned the charity’s beneficiary survey into clear insights for decision‑makers, and those insights secured a three‑year renewal of their funding. The analysis turned raw questionnaire data into actionable recommendations that were directly incorporated into their grant report.

title: Cleaning a research dataset before publication
summary: I cleaned a research dataset for an academic client using pandas, ensuring it met the journal's reproducibility standards. The cleaned data was accepted without further modification, allowing the paper to be published on schedule.

title: Paid-ads report for a small agency
summary: I built a daily auto-updating dashboard to track paid-ads performance for a small marketing agency. The client now saves hours each week by receiving accurate, fresh data without manual intervention.

title: Sales and labour dashboard for a restaurant group
summary: I built a daily sales and labour cost dashboard for a six‑site restaurant group, letting them see labour as a percentage of sales each day. The tool gave the owners clear insight and helped them keep costs under control.

title: Market sizing spreadsheet for a start-up pitch
summary: I built a bottom‑up total addressable market spreadsheet for a start‑up’s seed pitch, and the model was incorporated directly into their investor deck. The client could clearly show a realistic market size, helping them secure seed funding.

title: attribution-models
summary:
A dbt‑based pipeline that transforms raw GA4 event data into a tidy channel‑level acquisition cost table refreshed each morning.  
The resulting table powers a Looker Studio dashboard that helped reallocate 18 % of ad spend, reducing CAC by 11 %.

title: fernway-loads
summary: A Python‑based Airflow pipeline that extracts orders, customers and email engagement data each night, loads them into Snowflake and ensures the data is ready by 06:00 am for downstream reporting. It includes retry logic, back‑fill handling and simple logging.

title: kpi-sql-library
summary: A small dbt‑style SQL library that defines reusable views for core e‑commerce KPIs – revenue, average order value and repeat purchase rate. The views can be materialised in PostgreSQL and plugged into dashboards to speed up reporting.

title: retention-notebooks
summary: The repository builds a retention curve and fits a time‑to‑churn model for a set of user sign‑ups, then visualises the impact of two onboarding variants. It outputs weekly retention rates and a comparative survival plot.

title: survey-toolkit
summary: The repository processes a beneficiary survey, applies population weighting to ensure small neighbourhoods are represented, and generates clear Plotly charts of agree/disagree responses for trustees. The resulting visualisations are saved as HTML files for inclusion in reports.
